title: What If One Algorithm Erased $1 Trillion in Minutes?

scenes.text: What if a single computer program made the stock market plunge in minutes? One did.
On May 6, 2010, a firm began selling 75,000 futures contracts, worth about 4.1 billion dollars.
The program ignored price and time, and it sold for about 20 minutes in an already shaky market.
High-speed trading algorithms piled on, and the Dow lost almost 1,000 points within minutes.
About one trillion dollars of market value vanished. Exchanges later canceled nearly 21,000 trades.
Regulators added circuit breakers that pause trading when prices swing too fast.

description:
What if one algorithm crashed the market in minutes?
In the 2010 flash crash, a single automated sell program helped wipe about one trillion dollars off market value before prices rebounded.
What should we run through next?
